# MarkdownBlock > Assistant markdown output rendered to prose, with a header and copy-source action. This file matches the installed `markdown-block` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/markdown-block.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/markdown-block.md`. ## Registry dependencies - `code` - `core` - `markdown` - `scroll-area` - `use-copy-to-clipboard` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/markdown-block-knobs`: `markdownBlockKnobs`, types `MarkdownBlockKnobStyle` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-block`: `MarkdownBlock`, `MarkdownBlockHeader`, `MarkdownBlockTitle`, `MarkdownBlockCopy`, `MarkdownBlockContent`, types `MarkdownBlockProps`, `MarkdownBlockHeaderProps`, `MarkdownBlockTitleProps`, `MarkdownBlockCopyProps`, `MarkdownBlockContentProps` ## Composition ### Anatomy ```tsx ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { MarkdownBlock, MarkdownBlockContent, MarkdownBlockCopy, MarkdownBlockHeader, MarkdownBlockTitle, } from "@/components/control-ui/markdown-block"; import { noteMarkdown } from "@/src/registry/examples/shared"; // Shared demo driver, identical in both sources — twinning explained in chat-message.tsx. export function MarkdownBlockExample() { return (
); } ``` ## Anatomy Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `markdown-block` - `content` - `header` - `root` - `title` - `title-icon` ## Knobs Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin. ### markdown-block - `--cui-markdown-block-radius`: `var(--radius-panel)` - `--cui-markdown-block-background`: `var(--background)` - `--cui-markdown-block-border-color`: `var(--border)` - `--cui-markdown-block-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)` - `--cui-markdown-block-shadow`: `var(--shadow-sm)` - `--cui-markdown-block-header-border-color`: `var(--border)` - `--cui-markdown-block-header-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)` - `--cui-markdown-block-icon-background`: `oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / 0.08)` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/kits/markdown-block - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/markdown-block.json
